column7: Verifiable source of truth on the unsolved Cicada 3301 Liber Primus (LP2 pages 0-54, 12,956 runes): a rig that reproduces every known solved page, a machine-readable ledger of every attack ruled out, an oracle that adjudicates claimed solves, and plant-and-recover benchmarks. Verdict: OTP-class, NOT 'unsolvable'.
